fixes: Subtitles now land at the right time in the episode — the dev2.21 fix's check for whether the server's subtitle chunks were already timed could be fooled by a single early chunk, so no shift was applied and every line stayed in the first seconds. The check now looks at all chunks together, so the lines show when the dialogue lands.
Downloads no longer sit frozen at 99% while the file is being finished — the bar now jumps to 100% and the row says what it's doing: Wrapping up…, Adding subtitles…, Almost there…
App icon has more padding around the pink star.
